_description: Style-strength guide. Updated based on testing and user feedback.
_notes: Color-shift styles (palette changes) work at lower strengths since they just recolor
Textural styles (surface changes) need higher strengths to actually transform surfaces
Full transformation styles need moderate strength to stay recognizable
Model strength should usually be lower than BG to preserve subject anatomy
For photos where you want to keep the model untouched, use model_strength 0.0-0.1
Mask dilation helps when body parts (hands, arms) are misclassified as background

color_shift.description: Styles that primarily change the color palette

textural.description: Styles that change surface quality and texture

painterly.description: Styles that transform into a painting look

atmospheric.description: Styles that add mood/atmosphere (smoke, light, particles)

bold_transformation.description: Styles that heavily reimagine the image. Use with caution.

minimal_touch.description: For when you want to barely change the model and just transform the BG
minimal_touch.notes: Good for photos where the model already looks perfect and you just want an artistic background
